provenance.basis: Owner authorized the minimum negative classification and accounting assumptions for the internal prototype on 2026-09-10. These explicit case stipulations are newly authored review candidates, not extracted borrower records or approved facts.

institution.note: Synthetic institutional perimeter, not a real bank charter or a determination of reporting-size eligibility.

counterparty.note: Tests structural attributes, not the Alpha Manufacturing name. No inference that all financial companies are excluded from U.S. corporate exposures. U.S. credit-union statute is explanatory identity evidence, not an invented incorporation in Part 217.

ppp.note: Ordinary privately originated loan; program provenance is the negative gate. Neither a 2025 snapshot nor the borrower name proves that an outstanding loan is non-PPP.

accounting.note: All adjustments are explicit candidate zero balances at the fixed snapshot, not defaults. No elapsed unpaid interest is included. Allowance zero is a synthetic simplification requiring express human acceptance, NOT a CECL estimate or a consequence of performing status; GAAP compliance of a real loan is not certified. Gross amortized cost, net balance-sheet amount and Part 217 carrying value are distinct concepts even though their candidate amounts coincide. Do not subtract provisions and allowance again from the ordinary non-PCD regulatory measure.

market_risk.note: Ordinary domestic USD loan retained for investment; RC-D exclusion follows the explicit substance/intent facts, not mere failure to file a schedule. No institution-wide exemption from market-risk rules is asserted.

other_scope.note: Direct unsecured corporate debt for ordinary manufacturing operations, not a real-estate funding project, insurance asset, securitization, trade settlement or clearing arrangement. The fourteen existing NO screen outcomes remain unapproved candidates.

missing_or_changed_fact_policy: No material field may be silently defaulted. Missing, contradictory or positive exclusion facts invalidate this narrow source-closure assessment and require human re-review or rejection/deferment of the future path. This is a planning constraint, not implemented runtime validation.
approval_boundary: Owner willingness to act as accountable prototype reviewer is recorded in REVIEW.md. Final named human review and all activation fields remain unfilled; this file does not authorize execution.
candidate_outputs_policy: No Golden Case candidate output or accepted Sprint 01 fixture has been changed.
